we are rated 'Outstanding' by Ofsted
We are proud to announce that we are rated 'Outstanding' by Ofsted in all areas!
Read the full press release and report below
Welcome toLeigh Academy Molehill
a culture that enables pupils and staff to thrive
The sense of pride that we each feel here at Molehill is strengthened by our commitment to placing our pupils at the centre of their learning. Teachers have embedded a culture of high expectations; we will all do whatever it takes to create better life opportunities for our children who deserve the very best.
We care about our pupils and the communities we serve, and driven by our strong moral purpose we work together to achieve excellence for all, creating confident, resilient children.
Dr Danielle Hall | Principal
latest news & letters
Our Mission
Our pledge to parents is that we will provide every pupil with the knowledge, skills, self belief and motivation to be successful in their learning and lives.
By learning together we:
We are self-motivated and resilient. We are valuable members of a school and wider community. We will be the best that we can be!
Be Brave | Be Kind | Strive for the Best
Foster a lifelong love of learning.
Nurture spiritual, moral, social and cultural awareness.
Develop lively, enquiring minds.
Promote respect, responsibility and self discipline.
Build self-esteem and a sense of community.
Little Moles Nursery
Little Moles Nursery provides daily sessions and wrap-around care for children from 3 to 5 years old.
